target.title: fix: harden aerith native hook relay recovery
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Aerith/OpenClaw sessions can resume with a stale native hook relay handle after gateway or runtime recovery. When that happens, tool execution may fail with a persistent `Native hook relay unavailable` state even though the gateway has been restarted, leaving normal shell commands and recovery work blocked.

This PR hardens that path by:

- persisting native hook relay generation metadata with relay records;
- allowing a bounded bootstrap-generation mismatch during resumed session recovery instead of permanently rejecting the relay;
- adding Aerith runtime resilience diagnostics for relay/session/memory/runtime readiness;
- documenting the recovery workflow and diagnostic interpretation;
- installing `openssh-client` in the runtime image so Git/SSH recovery paths are available from the container;
- keeping the new `.mjs` resilience test in the correct Vitest tooling lane.

## Evidence

Local validation on the rebased branch:

- `node --check scripts/aerith-runtime-resilience.mjs`
- `node --check scripts/aerith-runtime-resilience.test.mjs`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts scripts/aerith-runtime-resilience.test.mjs --reporter=verbose` — 5 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit-fast.config.ts src/dockerfile.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 25 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts test/scripts/test-projects.test.ts -t "covers each normal full-suite test file exactly once" --reporter=verbose`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts test/vitest-scoped-config.test.ts -t "keeps tooling tests in their own lane" --reporter=verbose`
- `pnpm lint --threads=8 test/vitest-scoped-config.test.ts test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts scripts/aerith-runtime-resilience.test.mjs`
- `git diff --check`

Additional focused checks completed during the recovery work:

- Aerith runtime resilience diagnostic: 5/5
- Native hook relay CLI tests: 21/21
- Native hook relay registry tests: 75/75

Operational scope notes:

- No phoning.ai voice pipeline files were changed.
- No secrets were printed or committed.
- The PR branch is published from the fork because local HTTPS push had no configured credential and the GitHub connector is not allowed to create refs directly on `openclaw/openclaw`.
